parts.question: What did this label say about moderate renal impairment?

result.answer: The superseded German label for AX-17 (DE-AX17-LBL-038), which was in effect from 2025-02-03 to 2026-09-15, stated that the historical starting dose for moderate renal impairment was 50 mg OD [E1, E2]. This information is superseded [E1, E2].
